calls.title: GrowthBook <> SassyClassy - Intro
calls.summary: GrowthBook (Daniel Wathne, Growthbook Dorn) discussed their end-to-end experimentation platform with SassyClassy's Head of IT, Edwin Molina, and Nadeem Pedarnig, addressing pain points from previous tools (Shoplift/VWO) that caused flicker effects, poor performance, and inaccurate metrics on Shopify Plus. They explored GrowthBook's flexible client-side approach with Edge Workers to eliminate flicker, advanced data warehouse integration via BigQuery, and the trade-off of a more custom implementation versus simpler Shopify-native apps. Next steps include Daniel sending a call recording and resources, setting
